for their intended purpose they re not over broad they re not reckless and this bill simply deals with the notion that as time passes the statutes we have passed and the way they have been implemented in the past by the regulatory process the administrative branch of government can cause issues to arise where they are duplicative inconsistent outdated and so this bill simply charges the executive
